context: Checks that CI verification does not mutate files and write mode is reserved for local or dedicated fix jobs.

checklist.name: Removes write mode from CI
checklist.description: The required CI checks no longer run biome format --write

checklist.name: CI uses check or lint mode
checklist.description: CI runs Biome in a read-only check or lint mode

checklist.name: Explains why write mode in CI is harmful
checklist.description: Says write mode mutates files and obscures validation failures

checklist.name: Failures now surface
checklist.description: States a formatting problem will fail the CI step instead of being silently rewritten

checklist.name: Uses the Nx targets in CI
checklist.description: Runs the checks through nx run-many for the Biome lint and format targets

checklist.name: Offers a dedicated fix job if wanted
checklist.description: Says write mode may run in a separate dedicated fix job, not required checks

checklist.name: Keeps CI deterministic
checklist.description: Describes CI as deterministic and non-mutating

checklist.name: Does not weaken rules to pass CI
checklist.description: Does not turn rules off to make CI green

checklist.name: Retains the cache inputs
checklist.description: Keeps biome.json and the Biome dependency in the target cache inputs

checklist.name: Keeps lint and format authority singular
checklist.description: Does not leave a second tool also formatting the same files
